scope: Complete existing Phase I registered family scope with linked detailed identities; Phase II item inventory blocked pending exact archive. Not a decomposed production mesh estimate.
counting_policy: Identity deduplication by preserved family ID and source-file SHA256.
The 24 primary source-file records alias the full source index; never add them to 112.
Detailed character, creature, POI and system records refine families; never add these counts to a mesh total.
Family component descriptions are scope labels, not approved item IDs, finished meshes, clip counts or independently priced work.
Only byte integrity is tested here. Historical source CPU evidence is scoped; no render/import/approval evidence is inferred.
A future asset must explicitly map artifact paths and hashes to these requirement IDs; file counts never automatically close gates.

owner_reported_scope_not_locally_verifie.counting_policy: Reported overlapping scope descriptions only; no local files or IDs verified, not additive to Phase I counts.

phase_ii.resolution: Materialize exact archive through supported Library route, verify bytes, read README and INTEGRATION_PLAN, reconcile existing IDs before extending this inventory.

acceptance_gate_definitions.design_and_pixels: Inspect original reference pixels, resolve hidden views and retain exact reference IDs; creation authorization is not final art approval.
acceptance_gate_definitions.authoring: Real low-poly source .blend, measured scale/pivots, UV unwrap and exported textured PBR materials where applicable. A PNG or procedural code alone is not a mesh.
acceptance_gate_definitions.rig_and_animation: Articulation/deformation only when appropriate; verify bone weights, sockets, clip timing, interruption and contact. Static rocks need no rig.
acceptance_gate_definitions.lod_collision: Authored LODs and collision with roles separated; navigation and state swaps tested. Geometry counts alone do not establish quality.
acceptance_gate_definitions.portable_export: Actual GLB/glTF export with buffers, accessors, materials, textures, skin and animation checks applicable to asset type.
acceptance_gate_definitions.blender: Open/reimport actual deliverable and render source scene. Source .blend plus scripts required for authored meshes.
acceptance_gate_definitions.unreal: Actual engine import/runtime test, material/texture/animation mapping and collision/LOD evidence. An import recipe does not verify parity.
acceptance_gate_definitions.godot: Actual engine import/runtime test of final files and animation/material/collision behavior.
acceptance_gate_definitions.threejs: Actual load, render, animation, dispose and material tests using final files; preserve source castable IDs, bytes and behavior.
acceptance_gate_definitions.reference_visual_match: Inspect renders/contact sheets against original pixels; record artifact hashes and exact review scope. Build success is not art acceptance.
acceptance_gate_definitions.performance: Measure nominated target devices, memory, frame/rig/shader cost and streaming; budgets remain PROPOSED until measured.
acceptance_gate_definitions.final_art_approval: Explicit review of exact artifacts and intended use; PROPOSED designs do not become approved through implementation.

source_requirements.shape_language: Heavy crescent armor and weighted bell-coat scholar; offset orbit rings and spherical counterweights

palette.description: midnight indigo; charcoal; violet; antique silver
palette.rule: Preserve per-reference variants; no universal recolor or new hex palette silently approved.

scale.requirements: Calibrate against human scale/traversal envelope; dimensions are not approved from image labels alone.

animation_requirements: Counterbalanced orbit, slow compression then directional gravity release; avoid watery wave trails
Author required state transitions, interruption, recovery and root-motion policy; no shipped clips implied.
vfx_requirements: Counterbalanced orbit, slow compression then directional gravity release; avoid watery wave trails
Use source castable behavior when applicable; separate cosmetic response from authority.
audio_requirements: Deep resonant tones, orbiting metal ticks and airy pressure shifts
Authoring requirement only; no recovered realm audio files.
environment_interactions: Use contract-interaction-resolver; interactions bounded by object tags and owner scope.
Provide active, resolved and recovery state without permanent content loss.
lod_requirements: Author baseline/mid/high variants after target hardware is selected.
Preserve silhouette, gameplay tell and socket positions at distance.
Independent visual LOD must never alter authoritative hit shape.
collision_requirements: Use simple authored collision according to role; decorative detail is not collidable by default.
Separate movement/navigation, hit detection and interaction volumes.
Validate collision/nav swaps for every authored state.

requirements: Measure geometry, materials, overdraw, rig cost, memory and streaming in representative scenes.
No unmeasured performance claim or numerical budget approval.

production_requirements.acceptance_focus: Clip timing from source or approved design; root motion/in-place choice, socket grip, interruption and foot contact
